policy.derivation: next_index = max(existing suffix) + 1 per governed family, from the collections actually present

operator_override_conditions.family_valid: must be one of the seven governed families
operator_override_conditions.value_int: must be a plain int (bool rejected)
operator_override_conditions.reason_required: a non-empty stated reason is mandatory (manual counters are never silent history)
operator_override_conditions.not_below_floor: operator value must be >= derived floor (an operator cannot lower the floor)
operator_override_conditions.not_above_headroom: operator value must be <= derived floor + ALLOCATOR_INDEX_HEADROOM (10,000,000)
